paper_title: First results of the CERN Resonant WISP Search (CROWS)
notes: Microwave LSW experiment (CROWS) at CERN. Probes both hidden sector photons (HSP/dark photon, kinetic mixing chi) and ALPs (g_agamma). The dark photon result is the novel one probing previously unexplored parameter space: chi=4.1e-9 at m_gamma'=10.8 ueV (Fig.14). It also sets an ALP limit g=4.5e-8 GeV^-1 at m_a=7.2 ueV (Fig.13). Since this is an LSW experiment (not a DM haloscope), no local DM density is assumed. Only the single best-sensitivity point is given numerically in text; full exclusion curves are in figures. Chose DarkPhoton as it's the headline novel result, but the paper also constrains AxionPhoton.
